## Crown Princess Ammarah Quilor Ascends to Regency of The Empire of Kantrias.

**▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬**

As per the [thirtieth decree of His Imperial Majesty Emperor Arran Quilor](<https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2641295>), Crown Princess Ammarah Quilor has been designated as both Regent of the Empire as well as the Heir Apparent, taking on the governance of Kantrias and her colonies.

Having become Imperial Regent, the Crown Princess has instituted several Imperial Proclamations. Notably, [appointing the Dame Raeliana Eliebe Quilor as an Arbiter of the Tribunal of Irons](<https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2643299>), filling a long vacant seat.

Further, the Imperial Regent has put forth [reform pertaining to the organisation of the Kantrian Colonial system](<https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2643018>)- reorganising them so that Kantrias may have greater opportunity to thrive.

Finally, the Regent has [reshuffled government positions](<https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2642337>)- retiring Duke Caldemar Quilor of Lakspyria from the post of Privy Councillor of Recruitment, appointing Aster Mikella Helix-Caelorum as Chief Ambassador of the Imperial Ambassador Corps, and [replacing the long time Overseer of the Kylian Assembly](<https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2643293>), Dame Soci, with Ambis Helix-Caelorum.

We ask that you, our treaty allies and foreign friends congratulate the Crown Princess on her ascension to Regent, and wish the Emperor the best of times as he takes a step back from Nationstates.
